entities.name: Session-AMBR
entities.description: The session-AMBR (Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate) is provided by the network to the UE and is associated with a PDU session. It indicates the maximum bit rate for the session.

entities.name: PDU session
entities.description: A PDU (Protocol Data Unit) session is a logical connection between the UE and the network for data transmission.

entities.name: Averaging window
entities.description: The averaging window is a time period of two seconds used by the UE for enforcing the uplink rate limitation based on the session-AMBR.

entities.name: UL rate limitation
entities.description: The uplink rate limitation is enforced by the UE based on the session-AMBR value over the averaging window.

relations.description: The session-AMBR is associated with a PDU session.
The UL rate limitation is indicated by the session-AMBR.
The UE's enforcement of UL rate limitation uses the averaging window.
